title: Job record (Contract A)
description: Produced by component 2 (ingest). Consumed by components 1 (analysis) and 3 (web).

match_id.description: TBA match key, lowercase. NULL -- not the string 'unknown' -- when component 2 could not resolve it from video metadata. Contract E: 'returns the job with match_id: null if it cannot'.

local_path.description: Path to the downloaded segment. Null until status reaches 'downloaded'.

start_offset.description: Seconds. Position of the segment start within the original video. Add to t_seconds to get original-video time. 0 when the segment is the whole video.

duration.description: Segment duration in seconds. Null until the download reports it.

alliances.description: From TBA. Narrows bumper OCR to three candidates per side. Null when TBA has no data for the match; component 1 then falls back to raw OCR without elimination.

error.description: Human-readable failure reason. Required non-null when status is 'failed' -- doc 2 treats a failed download as an expected condition, and the queue cannot offer a useful retry without saying what went wrong.

progress.description: Not in doc 0. Proposed: see OPEN_QUESTIONS.md #4. Component 3 reads it if present and falls back to an indeterminate bar.

created_at.description: ISO 8601, UTC, Z suffix. Proposed: the queue cannot order by age without it.

allOf.$comment: Media metadata is unknowable before the download completes, but must be present once it has -- component 1 cannot decode without fps/width/height and component 3 cannot lay out a player without duration.
